'''Sirianna''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith Inquisitor]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] she at one point shared knowledge with the future [[Darth Nox]].
